newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal bond spreads could narrowly sharply.
newsitem.headline: Portugal bond spreads could narrowly sharply.

text.p: The spread between the Portuguese 10-year cash bond and the Bund equivalent could narrow to 40-50 basis points by the end of the year if it becomes clear Portugal will enter the single currency in the first wave, ESR-Espirito Santo Research said.
The spread currently stands at 113 basis points between the February 2007 fixed-rate bond (OT) and the Bund January 2007.
But ESR said that the shorter end of the yield curve had the potential for greatest gains, relative to Germany, because that was where the spread was widest.
"We could see a steepening of the yield curve in the OT," it said.
